The structure includes a continuous tubular handrail and vertical metal balusters that follow the incline of the stairs. The railing is anchored by thicker square posts at intervals. The background shows a concrete wall, grassy terrain, and trees.

The grass texture is somewhat uniform and repetitive, lacking natural variation, though this is common in AI generations and less critical than structural errors.
